summary: The fund invests at least 80% of its total assets in the securities of the underlying index. The underlying index seeks to provide broad exposure to thematic strategies using a portfolio of ETFs issued by Global X Funds® that target a specific theme or that has a significant overweight toward a particular theme (each, an “Underlying ETF”), as determined by the index orovider. It is non-diversified.
